brief: UI kit: a row of three buttons (primary, secondary, ghost) with editable label text, corner radius, size, optional leading icon (simple arrow/plus/sparkle drawn in paths), shadow toggle, brand colour. Rendered on a soft canvas as a component spec sheet. price 4

UI component: a SaaS pricing card with plan name, price, period, 3-6 feature rows with check marks, a CTA button, 'Most popular' ribbon toggle, light/dark theme choice, accent colour, corner radius. price 5

Device mockup: a modern smartphone frame (choice of notch: island, notch, none) displaying a generated app screen (header, card list, tab bar) in the user's brand colours, tilt choice flat/perspective-ish skew, background colour, shadow. price 6

Device mockup: a desktop browser window with traffic lights, URL bar text knob, light/dark chrome, showing a generated landing page wireframe (hero headline text knob, buttons, image placeholder, three feature columns). price 6
Dashboard UI: an analytics stat card with label text, big number text, delta percentage up/down choice, a smooth seeded sparkline or bar mini chart choice, accent colour, light/dark. price 3

Layout mockup: a bento-box grid landing section of 5-8 rounded tiles of varied spans, each with abstract mini-illustrations (rings, bars, dots, gradients) and short labels; knobs for gap, radius, tile count, palette, seed. price 8
UI component: a stacked set of 3 toast notifications (success, warning, error) with icons, title and body text, radius, density compact/comfortable, light/dark, accent tint strength. price 3

UI mockup: a messaging conversation of 4-6 alternating chat bubbles with editable first message text, bubble radius, tail on/off, sent colour, received colour, background, typing indicator toggle. price 4

Poster: International Typographic Style (Swiss) event poster with a strong grid, giant headline text knob, subline text, date text, geometric circle/bar composition driven by a seed, 3 colours, grid overlay toggle. A4 portrait. price 7

Poster: 80s synthwave sunset with a striped sun, perspective grid floor, mountains silhouette, headline text in a bold sans with chrome-like gradient; knobs for sun stripes, grid density, palette, headline. price 6

Poster: Bauhaus-inspired composition of circles, semicircles, quarter circles and bars on a modular grid, seeded; knobs for grid size, palette (primary red/yellow/blue default), headline text along the bottom, paper texture toggle. price 6

Graphic: a stylish event ticket / boarding-pass with perforated stub, event name text, date text, seat text, barcode drawn from a seed, accent colour, paper colour, holographic gradient toggle. price 4

Brand mark: monogram logo from 1-3 letters text knob inside a container (circle, squircle, hexagon, shield, none), font style choice serif/sans/mono, weight via stroke, colours, outline vs solid. price 9

Brand mark: abstract geometric logo symbol built from rotated arcs/petals around a centre (like a modern tech brand mark); knobs for petals count, rotation, gap, roundness, two colours, gradient toggle, wordmark text knob below. price 9

Social media graphic: an Instagram square quote card with big quote text knob, author text, oversized quote marks, background style choice (solid/gradient/paper), accent colour, alignment choice. price 3

Social graphic: a bold YouTube-style thumbnail layout 1280x720 with huge 2-3 word headline text, a highlighted word colour, abstract shapes and an arrow, background gradient, sticker badge text. price 4

Pattern: topographic contour lines generated from seeded smooth noise (implement a small value-noise + marching squares or layered sine fields), knobs for line count, line width, scale, two colours, filled terraces toggle. price 5

Pattern: playful Memphis-design confetti — squiggles, triangles, dots, zigzags, circles scattered with seeded jitter and Poisson-ish spacing; knobs for density, size, stroke, 4 colours, background. price 4
Pattern: terrazzo stone chips in random polygon shards on a base colour, seeded; knobs for chip count, chip size, 4 chip colours, base colour, speckle toggle. price 4
Web section divider: layered smooth waves (2-5 layers) for the bottom of a hero section; knobs for layers, amplitude, frequency, seed, gradient from colour to colour, flip, height. 1440x320. price 0
Background: halftone dot field where dot size follows a radial or linear gradient, choice of shape (circle, square, diamond), knobs for spacing, angle, focal point, two colours. price 0

Illustration: a tiny isometric city block of buildings with windows, rooftops and a couple of trees on a tile; knobs for grid size, building height variance, seed, palette (day, dusk, night presets), window lights toggle. price 10
Illustration: a potted plant (monstera / snake plant / fern choice) in a minimal flat style, pot shape choice, leaf count range, pot and leaf colours, background colour, shadow toggle. price 5

Illustration: layered mountain ranges receding with atmospheric perspective, sun or moon, optional birds and clouds; knobs for layers, jaggedness, seed, time-of-day palette, sun position. 1600x900 wallpaper. price 6

Illustration: a calm desert oasis scene — dunes, a pool of water with reflection, 2-4 palm trees, sun; flat editorial style; knobs for palm count, dune layers, seed, palette (noon, golden hour, night). price 8

UI illustration: a friendly empty-state illustration (e.g. an empty inbox tray / folder with floating sparkles) above a title text and description text, brand colour, line or filled style choice. 800x600. price 4

Illustration: spot illustration of an abstract character (rounded body, simple face) doing an action choice (waving, reading, celebrating, thinking), with skin/shirt/background colours and accessory toggle. price 5
Generative art: flow-field lines following seeded smooth noise, knobs for line count, length, curl, stroke width, palette of 3 colours, background, line style (straight/dashed/dotted). price 6
Generative art: concentric offset rings / circles with interference, a modern op-art look, knobs for ring count, offset, stroke width, rotation, two colours, filled alternating toggle. price 3
UI: a glassmorphism credit/membership card floating over colourful blurred orbs, card holder name text, card number last-4 text, brand mark, glass opacity, orb colours, chip toggle. price 5
UI component: a month calendar widget with month name text, selected day range, today marker, event dots seeded, start of week choice, accent colour, light/dark, radius. price 4
UI: activity progress rings (1-3 concentric) with percentages, labels below, stroke width, rounded caps, three ring colours, track opacity, dark/light. price 2
Type: a stylised display wordmark from text knob, with style choice (outlined, stacked shadow, stencil, gradient fill), letter spacing, skew, colours. 1200x400. price 6
Sticker sheet: 6 cute die-cut stickers (heart, star, lightning, smiley, flower, cloud) with thick white outlines and drop shadows, palette knobs, outline width, rotation jitter seed. price 3

App icon: an iOS-style squircle app icon with a central glyph choice (camera, note, wave, leaf, bolt, compass) built from paths, background gradient two colours, glyph colour, gloss toggle, depth shadow. 1024x1024. price 5
Design resource: a colour palette swatch card showing 5 swatches with hex labels (computed from knobs), palette name text, layout choice (stripes, circles, cards), corner radius. price 0
